title: Grill round 3: replacing prUrl with a list, and Create all PRs on single-repo tasks

pr-url-column.title: Migration 092 copies each single-repo task's `pr_url` into the new list. What happens to the old `tasks.pr_url` column?
pr-url-column.display: Keep the column, stop reading and writing it

task-json-field.title: The Task JSON (`GET /tasks`, `agetor ls --json`): what happens to the `prUrl` field?
task-json-field.display: Add `prs`; keep `prUrl` as a deprecated, derived read-only field (the first PR's URL), never read by agetor itself

pr-entry-shape.title: Shape of one PR entry
pr-entry-shape.value: `{ url: string, head: string, base: string, number: number | null, createdAt: number }`, in creation order. A repository's (or single-repo task's) **live-head PR** is the one whose `head` matches its branch, not just the first item.

single-repo-trigger.title: On a single-repo task, when does Create all PRs appear?
single-repo-trigger.display: When the newest matching proposals name **two or more distinct heads** that don't have a PR yet; shown next to the existing Create PR chip

view-pr-many.title: "View PR" (run panel link, task card, right-click menu) when a task or repository has several PRs?
view-pr-many.display: List them all: the run panel shows each `head → base` link; the context menu gets one "View PR: <head>" item per PR (a submenu past 3)

c-server-managed.title: Server-managed rules for the new columns
c-server-managed.value: `tasks.base_branch` and `tasks.prs` are server-managed (not in `ALLOWED_PATCH_FIELDS`, skipped by the generic SET, never bump `updated_at`, written by targeted UPDATEs). Both go in migration 092, and the CLAUDE.md list is updated.

c-pipeline-step.title: Pipeline steps
c-pipeline-step.value: A new step's task-level `prs` starts empty (as `prUrl: null` does today, `pipeline-runner.ts:1441`). Its `baseBranch` is copied from the parent like `baseRef` (`:1434`). Its `repositories[]`, each entry's `prs` and `baseBranch` included, are copied from the parent as they are today (`:1437`).
